control_name: Every source extract file is ingested
detail: one parsed partition per file present in data/raw

control_name: Row counts survive ingestion
detail: parsed rows equal the data rows in the extract files, counted independently

control_name: Windows-1252 text decodes without loss
detail: no replacement character in any Kestrel German account or item text

control_name: Every amount parses under its declared locale
detail: German point-thousands / comma-decimal and US thousands separators

control_name: Every posting date parses
detail: ISO, US MM/DD/YYYY and German DD.MM.YYYY

control_name: Posting dates fall inside their own accounting period
detail: special periods 13-16 are excluded: they carry a December date by design

control_name: Kestrel account keys keep their leading zeros as text
detail: an eight-character key coerced to a number loses its leading zeros silently

control_name: Every amount matches its system's declared numeric grammar
detail: AURORA: plain decimal, point separator; SABLE: US notation: comma thousands, point decimal; KESTREL: German notation: point thousands, comma decimal

control_name: Every line has a unique lineage key
detail: erp | file | journal | line, the declared grain of the conformed fact

control_name: Row ordinals are dense within every file
detail: 1..N per file, so a dropped row is visible

control_name: Kestrel special periods are classified, not numbered
detail: 13 statutory close, 14 audit, 15 tax, 16 group reporting; all report in month 12

control_name: No thirteenth month can reach a management view
detail: the accounting period is retained; the reporting month is capped at December

control_name: Source-system translated amounts never reach a calculation
detail: {'AURORA': 'AMOUNT_USD_SYSTEM', 'KESTREL': 'DMBTR_KONZERN_EUR'} are carried on the journal-line fact for lineage only and are absent from every aggregate

control_name: Native trial balance closes in each ERP's own convention
detail: re-derived from the parsed layer: Aurora signed, Kestrel SOLL less HABEN, Sable natural sign against the approved chart

control_name: Trial balance closes after sign normalisation
detail: per entity and accounting period

control_name: Trial balance still closes after mapping
detail: mapping is classification only: it may not move a cent

control_name: No statistical account enters the trial balance
detail: statistical accounts are outside the balancing population

control_name: Mapping changes no amount
detail: the standardised and mapped amounts agree line for line

control_name: No account class has had its sign inverted
detail: assets carry debit balances, liabilities, equity and revenue carry credits; contra and genuinely bidirectional accounts are named and excluded, never inferred. The accepted exception is contract assets at the Kestrel entities, driven into a credit balance by unclassified accrued-income postings. Accepted at 7 account-entity-years pending Phase 2.3 source correction.

control_name: No line is left unresolved
detail: an unresolved line goes to data/10_staging/exceptions/mapping_exceptions.csv and blocks the close; it never defaults silently

control_name: No line matches more than one rule branch
detail: priority does not resolve an ambiguity, it hides one: a line matching two branches is an exception, not a lookup

control_name: Mapping agrees with the acceptance oracle where the source classified the line
detail: the expected-mapping manifest is read here and nowhere else; the engine derives the group account from the approved charts and rules alone

control_name: Mapping agreement across every line
detail: 1080616 of 1080782 lines agree with the oracle (99.984641%). Every disagreement is a posting the source system left unclassified; see P3-MAP-13. Accepted at 166 journal lines pending Phase 2.3 source correction.

control_name: Every mapping is effective at the posting date
detail: effective-dated mappings are evaluated against the posting date, not the load date

control_name: Every conditional account declares a default branch
detail: a split with no default is a silent fall-through waiting to happen

control_name: Every rule target exists and is not statistical
detail: CTL-MAP-02, CTL-MAP-03

control_name: No orphan source account
detail: every account posted to in an extract exists in that ERP's approved chart

control_name: Mapping coverage of value, not just of codes
detail: CTL-MAP-05: an unmapped rounding line and an unmapped acquisition are not the same problem

control_name: German total-cost-method items are reclassified into cost of sales
measured: 613/613 to cost of sales, 0 left in revenue
detail: Bestandsveraenderung and aktivierte Eigenleistungen sit above the revenue line under the Gesamtkostenverfahren and inside cost of sales under the group's cost-of-sales presentation

control_name: Every presentation reclassification is flagged and traceable
detail: the source presentation stays visible on the line: source account, source account name in German, and the reclassification type

control_name: A line's declared function agrees with the cost centre it was posted to
detail: 51,099,616 local. The posting declares one classification and sits in a cost centre carrying another. The declared attribute is authoritative for the mapping contract, so the mapping is right; the source data is not self-corroborating. Accepted at 5710 journal lines pending Phase 2.3 source correction.

control_name: Every posting to a conditional account carries the attribute its rules read
detail: 67142 postings carry no attribute their account's rules read. Opening-balance, year-end-close and special-period journals are written without the line attributes the mapping contract requires, so the split cannot be derived. Accepted at 166 journal lines pending Phase 2.3 source correction.

control_name: Every entity resolves to a real operating entity
detail: an elimination entity must never appear in a source extract

control_name: Every cost centre resolves to the master
detail: CTL-DQ-08

control_name: Every currency is in the approved set
detail: USD, CAD, GBP, EUR

control_name: Every group account resolves to the group chart
detail: CTL-DQ-08 referential integrity

control_name: Every intercompany partner is valid and never the posting entity
detail: CTL-IC-04

control_name: Kestrel's native cost centre agrees with the resolved one
detail: Aurora and Sable carry no cost centre and one is resolved from the department; Kestrel carries KOSTL, and the same resolution must reproduce it

control_name: No dimension has a duplicate natural key
detail: including effective-dated dimensions, where a duplicate key would make the as-at lookup non-deterministic

control_name: Intercompany postings carry a partner
detail: CTL-IC-04. The invoice leg of every intercompany flow carries its counterparty; the cash settlement leg, the treasury current account and the intercompany loans do not, so an intercompany BALANCE cannot be attributed to an entity pair. The opening balance and the year-end close are excluded as positions rather than transactions. Accepted at 5248 journal lines pending Phase 4 elimination engine.

control_name: Affiliate interest is separated from third-party interest
detail: CTL-IC-05: affiliate interest left in the third-party accounts overstates consolidated net interest, because it does not eliminate

control_name: FX rates are complete for every currency and period in use
detail: CTL-FX-01. A missing rate must block the period, not translate at zero

control_name: Source amounts survive standardisation
detail: absolute value by ERP, before and after sign normalisation

control_name: Mapped income statement reconciles to the source-layer target
detail: revenue, cost of sales and operating expense, FY2023-FY2025, against config/anchors/phase02_source_layer_targets.csv

control_name: Mapped balance sheet agrees with the acceptance oracle
detail: worst 2.3344m (28.55%). Contract assets and prepayments differ because seven Kestrel postings to 00017000 carry no accrual type and resolve to the default branch. Accepted at 6 balance sheet caption-years pending Phase 2.3 source correction.

control_name: Mapped balance sheet reconciles to the source-layer target
detail: four captions carry a documented source finding and are reported separately by P3-REC-03 and P3-REC-08

control_name: Revenue detail reconciles to the mapped general ledger
detail: ADR-0008: customer and product detail lives in its own fact at its own grain and must tie to the ledger. It is never pushed into the journal-line fact

control_name: Gross margin by business unit reproduces the anchor
detail: THE control that catches a mapping which is wrong but still balances: move production payroll into SG&A and every other control still passes

control_name: External revenue by entity reproduces the anchor
The trial balance fact ties to the journal-line fact
detail: the aggregate is built from the detail, so the two cannot drift apart

control_name: Planning data is complete and no reserved version leaks
detail: CTL-SCN-06. Superseded forecasts are retained; the Downside shell is not populated; Prior Year is derived, never stored (ADR-0004)

control_name: Special-period reclassifications stay inside one anchored caption
detail: worst 0.126m. Kestrel special period 15 reallocates between corporate income tax and trade tax, which moves an amount from the income-taxes-payable caption into accrued liabilities. P2-FMT-09 tested that a special period does not move the year's RESULT; it does not test the balance sheet captions. Accepted at 6 balance sheet caption-years pending Phase 2.3 source correction.

control_name: Prior Year is not materialised as a scenario
detail: ADR-0004: derived by date offset from Actual

control_name: Every operating entity carries direct labour in cost of sales
detail: an entity that manufactures or delivers with no direct labour has had its payroll mapped into operating expenses

control_name: Payroll splits plausibly across the gross margin line
detail: the share of employment cost inside cost of sales stays inside a plausible band for a manufacturing or services unit; this is the shape CTL-MAP-04 protects

control_name: No cumulative translation adjustment or reserve exists at layer 1
detail: CTA is created by translation at layer 5 and NCI by consolidation at layer 3. A source-layer balancing plug is a blocking defect (ADR-0017)

control_name: Phase 3 posts no group adjustment
detail: the staging table exists so the consolidation engine has somewhere to raise a top-side entry; ingestion never writes to it

control_name: Phase 3 produces layer 1 only
detail: no elimination, no consolidation adjustment, no management layer, no CTA

control_name: Every entity has every period from its effective date
No entity posts before its consolidation effective date
detail: CTL-CON-02, tested at ingestion rather than at consolidation

control_name: Group accounts with no source postings
detail: CTL-MAP-06: an account created by translation or consolidation is expected to be empty at layer 1; an account a source chart maps to and never posts is not
